coastal_garden.label: Coastal native garden
coastal_garden.conditions: Torrey pine and Shaw's agave have restricted native contexts; planted regional options, not universal county defaults. Choose one sunflower identity deliberately. Keep flowering/water states coherent.
coastal_garden.state_selection_rule: Default/option keys select one primary whole-plant variant per chosen instance. Alternative states replace that variant at its adjusted anchor/scale, never auto-spawn alongside it.

shaded_oak.label: Shaded oak yard / bright perimeter
shaded_oak.conditions: Bright-edge/managed-moisture composition candidates only; no claim these are all deep-shade plants. Source backgrounds may contain baked oak. No independent usable oak tree from these local sources: Engelmann wood/canopy attachment HOLD; coast live oak exists only in earlier external references, not an audited local sprite.
shaded_oak.state_selection_rule: Default/option keys select one primary whole-plant variant per chosen instance. Alternative states replace that variant at its adjusted anchor/scale, never auto-spawn alongside it.

mediterranean_courtyard.label: Mediterranean courtyard / planted patio
mediterranean_courtyard.conditions: Two default pots are cultivated, not native. Ivy geranium needs an elevated ledge/table anchor and visible trailing foliage. Optional regional plants are independent planted beds/rosettes; do not invent a separate pot for flattened rooted sprites.
mediterranean_courtyard.state_selection_rule: Default/option keys select one primary whole-plant variant per chosen instance. Alternative states replace that variant at its adjusted anchor/scale, never auto-spawn alongside it.

existing_inland.label: Existing inland canyon / foothill garden
existing_inland.conditions: Sycamore is a large moist-pocket/riparian/irrigated option, not the default dry hill tree. Other plants retain source moisture/season needs. Revised needlegrass remains provisional, with fine-awn readability pending.
existing_inland.state_selection_rule: Default/option keys select one primary whole-plant variant per chosen instance. Alternative states replace that variant at its adjusted anchor/scale, never auto-spawn alongside it.

existing_patio.label: Existing patio / sheltered nursery option boundary
existing_patio.conditions: Indoor-tagged stock is not an automatic outdoor patio option; show only in a deliberately sheltered/interior placement mode. Outdoor wind/weather default disabled. Pothos and spider plant require elevated shelf/table placement.
existing_patio.state_selection_rule: Default/option keys select one primary whole-plant variant per chosen instance. Alternative states replace that variant at its adjusted anchor/scale, never auto-spawn alongside it.
